title: Applied AI Essentials
description: Learn to use modern AI tools for real work: research, writing, analysis, coding, and automation.
stagesNote: The weeks are grouped by how much the AI does on its own, from chat to agents that work while you are away.

text.lessons: The full text for each topic, grouped by week. Each week ends with its lab and assignment. Read a topic before class or use it to review afterward.
text.slides: The decks presented in class, one per topic. Use the arrow keys to move through a deck press F for full screen, and press Esc to come back to this page.
text.resources: Videos, short courses, articles, and standards that go with each week. Everything is free unless it says otherwise.
text.projects: Longer projects that put several weeks of the course to work on something you will keep using. Each page says what the project involves and what you need to have covered first.
text.appendix: Material outside the weekly outline, for background and further reading. Nothing here is assigned.

projects.name: Build a Personal Assistant
projects.about: Set up a Claude project that knows how you work and can reach your task list and notes through connectors such as Todoist and Notion.

appendix.name: The History of AI
appendix.about: From the first ideas about thinking machines to today's large language models: the main approaches, the booms and winters, and the breakthroughs behind modern AI.

demos.name: Next-Token Sampler
demos.about: Watch a model pick one token at a time, and see why the same prompt gives different answers on different runs.

demos.name: Context Window Budget
demos.about: Fill a context window with instructions, files, and conversation, and see what gets crowded out.

demos.name: Prompt Injection Sandbox
demos.about: Hide instructions in a document and see when an agent follows them and which safeguards stop it.

demos.name: Tool-Use Tracer
demos.about: Step through one tool call, from the model's request to the program's reply and back.

demos.name: Retrieval and Evaluation Explorer
demos.about: Change how documents are chunked and retrieved, then score the answers against a test set.
